description: Find the top 3 products by units sold within each category for Q1 2025 (sale_date from 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31 inclusive). Use RANK() semantics: products with equal units share a rank and the following rank is skipped; return every product whose rank is <= 3. Output columns: category (STRING), product_id (INT64), units_sold (INT64), sales_rank (INT64). Sort by category, sales_rank, product_id.
edge_cases: Ties at rank 1 mean the next product is rank 3, not rank 2
Sale on 2025-03-31 is in range; sale on 2025-04-01 is not
Products with no sales in the quarter must not appear
Category with fewer than 3 products returns all of them
common_failure_modes: FM3: Ranking individual sale rows instead of first aggregating units per product
FM4: Using ROW_NUMBER() or LIMIT 3 arbitrarily drops tied products; using DENSE_RANK() returns a 4th product
